text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
That concludes your morning official 
duties. There's a break before your next 
engagement—what would you like to do?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that true? In that case... I think 
I'll go for a short walk.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. It suddenly feels just a little 
too quiet.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be because the days I spent 
running with everyone were so lively and 
fulfilling?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Those days were my youth. Researching 
what I love most together with my friends— 
a time fleeting and brilliant, like 
fireworks.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(It's sad to think that, little by 
little... even if just by fractions, it 
will eventually weather away.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Huh? This smell is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ I can't help but smile. I had no 
idea a shop like this opened up around 
here too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Ramen really is the best! With every 
bite, the savory flavor just bursts out—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Those precious days are coming back to 
me.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I see. So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There was never any need to feel reluctant 
to part!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Because the taste and aroma trigger it... 
and every time I eat ramen, I can 
remember.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Memories with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was working off-site today, and before I 
knew it, it had gotten quite late into the 
night.
choice_data_list:
If I go home and cook now... that'd be too 
late, huh?

If I go home and cook now... that'd be too 
late, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was thinking about grabbing 
whatever at an eatery along the way home, 
an appetizing aroma drifted over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All other options lingering in my mind 
vanished. Well then. To give it my all 
tomorrow too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Maybe I'll have ramen today."
